title: Start Game: Marine Reptile Guessing Level

layer_3_action.subject: A mysterious gathering of Marine Reptile silhouettes
features: A massive Mosasaurus hoffmannii in the center foreground, rendered as a solid, dark teal-to-black silhouette with sharp, recognizable outlines of its fins and snout.
A smaller, agile Clidastes silhouette darting in the upper right, its sleek profile contrasting against the light rays.
A Globidens silhouette near the bottom left, identifiable by its more robust, blunt head shape, positioned near high-contrast ammonites.
All characters are completely backlit, hiding colors and facial features to create a 'Who's that Pokemon?' style mystery.
layer_3_action.action: The silhouettes are arranged in a dynamic formation, swimming toward the viewer, backlit by intense surface light.

text_overlay.style: Bright red, 3D extruded clay-style lettering, mixed case, playful bold sans-serif font.
text_overlay.placement: Center, slightly arched over the main central silhouette.

visual_logic.water: Deep slate-blue water with high-contrast, shimmering 'god-rays' coming from directly behind the central Mosasaur to emphasize its silhouette.
visual_logic.atmosphere: Abundant silver bubbles and floating marine snow to catch the light, framing the dark shapes of the predators.
